title: Let's Learn English Level 2 Lesson 7
subtitle: Tip Your Tour Guide
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 2, Lesson 7: Tip Your Tour Guide (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Welcome back! Anna and Penelope are taking a tour with DC Ducks. In this lesson, we are looking for prepositions. Listen for in, on, at, under and over - some important prepositions of place.
dialogue.zh: 歡迎回來！安娜和佩內洛普正在坐 DC Ducks 遊覽。這一課我們找介詞。注意聽 in、on、at、under 和 over——這些重要的地點介詞。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Penelope, the Lincoln Memorial is coming up on your left!
dialogue.zh: 佩內洛普，林肯紀念堂馬上出現在你左邊！

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: You’re going to love my Lincoln Memorial Fun Fact!
dialogue.zh: 你們一定會喜歡我這條林肯紀念堂趣聞！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh, please tell us!
dialogue.zh: 哦，快告訴我們！

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: On a wall inside the memorial, the word “FUTURE” was carved wrong! They carved “EUTURE”!
dialogue.zh: 紀念堂裡面的牆上，“FUTURE”這個詞刻錯了！他們刻成了“EUTURE”！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, we all make mistakes.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，誰都會犯錯。

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: Yeah, but this mistake was carved in stone!
dialogue.zh: 對，可這個錯誤是刻在石頭上的！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You’re right. That is pretty bad. Here’s another dollar!
dialogue.zh: 你說得對。那確實挺糟。再給你一美元！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: More fun facts, please! (Crossing the river) I love riding over bridges! The water looks so pretty from here!
dialogue.zh: 再來點趣聞！（過河）我喜歡從橋上過去！從這兒看水面好漂亮！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Penelope, this is amazing! A minute ago, we were riding along the river, and now we’re riding in the river! Awesome.
dialogue.zh: 佩內洛普，太神奇了！一分鐘前我們還沿著河邊走，現在我們在河裡開！太棒了。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Hey, we’re passing by the Pentagon on our right!
dialogue.zh: 嘿，我們右邊正經過五角大樓！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Penelope, you love riding over the water on a bridge. But I love riding under a bridge in a boat!
dialogue.zh: 佩內洛普，你喜歡從橋上過水麵。可我喜歡坐船從橋下過！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Anna, look! An airplane is flying right over our heads!
dialogue.zh: 安娜，看！一架飛機正好從我們頭頂飛過！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Wow! This is the closest I’ve ever been to an airplane in flight. Well, I’ve been inside a flying airplane. But not outside of an airplane as it flies over my head!
dialogue.zh: 哇！這是我離飛行中的飛機最近的一次。嗯，我坐過飛行中的飛機裡面。但從來沒在飛機外面，看它從我頭頂飛過！

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: And now we’re driving out of the water. I still can’t believe this thing drives and sails!
dialogue.zh: 現在我們正從水裡開出來。我還是不敢相信這東西既能開又能航行！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I know. It’s amazing.
dialogue.zh: 我知道。太神奇了。

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: After we ride along these railroad tracks, you’ll see my favorite part of the tour! The U.S. Treasury where they make money!
dialogue.zh: 沿這些鐵軌走過後，你們會看到我最喜歡的一段！美國財政部，他們在那兒印錢！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: That young man is making a lot of money, too. Did you hear these prepositions? On your left, on our right, in the river, over bridges, over our heads, over my head, on a bridge. As you watch more, look for 'inside' and 'outside.'
dialogue.zh: 那個小夥子也賺了不少錢。你聽到這些介詞了嗎？on your left、on our right、in the river、over bridges、over our heads、over my head、on a bridge。接著看時，找找 inside 和 outside。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: Look, the U.S. Capitol is coming up!
dialogue.zh: 看，美國國會大廈出現了！

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: I have a great Fun Fact about the U.S. Capitol.
dialogue.zh: 我有一條關於國會大廈的超棒趣聞。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: What is it?
dialogue.zh: 是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: There are tunnels under the Capitol. They connect the Capitol and office buildings of lawmakers.
dialogue.zh: 國會大廈下面有隧道。它們連線國會大廈和議員的辦公樓。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I bet they built them years ago for secret reasons!
dialogue.zh: 我敢說他們多年前是為了秘密原因才建的！

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: No. The lawmakers did not want to walk around outside in bad weather.
dialogue.zh: 不是。議員們不想在壞天氣裡在外面走。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Oh.
dialogue.zh: 哦。

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: We’re back at Union Station!
dialogue.zh: 我們回到聯合車站了！

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: Do you want to know a creepy Fun Fact about Union Station? (he points to Union Station)
dialogue.zh: 想聽一條關於聯合車站的詭異趣聞嗎？（他指著聯合車站）

dialogue.speaker: Penelope
dialogue.en: The creepier the better!
dialogue.zh: 越詭異越好！

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: Many years ago, inside Union Station, there was a funeral home!
dialogue.zh: 很多年前，聯合車站裡面有一家殯儀館！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: A funeral home?! You mean, for dead people?!
dialogue.zh: 殯儀館？！你是說，給死人用的？！

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: Do you know another kind of funeral home?
dialogue.zh: 你還知道別的那種殯儀館嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No!
dialogue.zh: 不知道！

dialogue.speaker: Boy
dialogue.en: Well, I’ve gotta run!
dialogue.zh: 好了，我得走了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks for giving us the great tour!
dialogue.zh: 謝謝你給我們做了這麼棒的講解！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Captain, that was awesome! And your son is a great tour guide!
dialogue.zh: 船長，太棒了！你兒子是個很棒的導遊！

dialogue.speaker: Captain
dialogue.en: What son?
dialogue.zh: 什麼兒子？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Him.
dialogue.zh: 他啊。

dialogue.speaker: Captain
dialogue.en: I’ve never seen that boy in my life! See ya, ladies!
dialogue.zh: 我這輩子從沒見過那個男孩！再見，女士們！

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: I learned many new Fun Facts in this lesson. Did you learn about prepositions? Here’s a list of all the prepositions used in this lesson. Wow! That’s a lot! I know, let’s not read them. Let’s sing them!
dialogue.zh: 這一課我學到很多新趣聞。你學到介詞了嗎？這裡列出了本課用到的所有介詞。哇！真多！我知道，咱們別唸了。唱出來吧！

quiz.prompt: What was carved wrong inside the Lincoln Memorial?
choices: The word FUTURE was carved as EUTURE

quiz.prompt: Why were tunnels built under the U.S. Capitol?
choices: So lawmakers would not walk outside in bad weather

quiz.prompt: Who is the boy who told the Fun Facts?
choices: A boy the captain has never seen
